answer: Each new agent must take a registered letter whose seal is a quartz wafer covering a one-time pearl code, delivered only to one residential address in a stated city or river delta. The operator locks 0.5 BTC for 180 days; shared mailboxes, cloned GPS traces, or repeated failed deliveries get slashed. Spinning up 1,000 sybils therefore costs 500 BTC of locked capital plus courier fees and rent for 1,000 distinct, deliverable addresses.
